import json
import os
import shutil
import sys

MAX_ENTRIES = 30
MAX_FILE_SIZE = 15 * 1024 * 1024
CHUNK_PREFIX = ".part"
MANIFEST = "manifest.jsonl"

def dir_for_index(index, total):
    parts = []
    i = index
    n = total
    depth = 0
    while n > MAX_ENTRIES and depth < 8:
        bucket = (i * MAX_ENTRIES + n - 1) // n
        parts.append(str(bucket).zfill(2))
        n = (n + MAX_ENTRIES - 1) // MAX_ENTRIES
        i = i - bucket * n
        depth += 1
    return os.path.join(*parts) if parts else ""

def main():
    print(dir_for_index(5, 100))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
